about: Goes round for as long as you want it to. Stop it when you are done. Its timers reach you with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
name: Fifty-two and seventeen

steps.about: One thing. The number comes from watching people who get a lot done, not from a theory.
steps.title: Fifty-two minutes

steps.about: Away, not a different screen. This is the half people skip and then wonder why the second hour was worse.
steps.title: Seventeen minutes away from it
